description: The bundle-freshness check group must delegate to the canonical freshness engine via `vrooli scenario freshness --json` (content-hash based) rather than re-implementing staleness detection. False-negative cases that mtime-only checks miss — such as a `file:`-dependency change or a `NODE_ENV` flip with an unchanged `ui/src` — must be reported as stale.

requirements.description: The bundle-freshness check group must delegate to the canonical freshness engine by invoking `vrooli scenario freshness --json` and translating its content-hash verdict into ui-health Findings. ui-health must not maintain a parallel staleness implementation.
requirements.title: Freshness check delegates to canonical engine

validation.notes: The freshness check group invokes the canonical freshness engine and consumes its --json output
A stale verdict from the engine maps to a freshness Finding in the consolidated Report
Run ui-health against a scenario the canonical engine reports stale and confirm a freshness Finding is emitted
ui-health contains no independent mtime-walk or hash implementation for freshness; the canonical engine is authoritative

requirements.description: Content-hash freshness must catch false-negative cases that mtime-only detection misses. A change to a `file:`-linked dependency or a `NODE_ENV` flip, even with an unchanged `ui/src` tree, must result in a stale verdict surfaced as a freshness Finding.
requirements.title: file:-dep and NODE_ENV changes report stale

validation.notes: A changed file:-dependency with unchanged ui/src yields a stale verdict
A NODE_ENV flip with unchanged ui/src yields a stale verdict
Run ui-health after changing a file:-dep and confirm the freshness Finding marks the bundle stale
Run ui-health after a NODE_ENV flip and confirm the freshness Finding marks the bundle stale
Content-hash freshness eliminates the mtime-only false-negatives for dependency and environment changes

title: Bundle freshness via canonical engine
